title: Characterization and progression of interstitial lung diseases in systemic autoimmune disease
summary: This study aims to take a closer look at patients with a specific lung disease that is associated with an autoimmune disorder. It examines how the disease presents and progresses under everyday clinical conditions – that is, in real-life situations rather than idealized study settings. The goal is to gain a better understanding of the condition and its impact on patients in routine medical care.

interventions.name:
• Demographic data: age, sex, body mass index (BMI), smoking status, and relevant pre-existing conditions
• Pulmonary function diagnostics: spirometry to assess vital capacity and forced expiratory volume in one second (FEV₁); body plethysmography to measure airway resistance and lung volumes; diff

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Systemic autoimmune diseases with interstitial lung disease
Exclusion criteria:
Age <18 years
ILD of another cause
Missing informed consent
